about: T1215 (register row T1156-e): the parse-booking failure-case set. Each case is a made-up document (.example domains) with a planted bad model answer, run through the shipped text-import path (runDoc in scripts/eval/adapters/parse-booking.mjs). `caught` records whether the shipped path removes the fault today; false is a known gap, listed in docs/ai/model-card-parse-booking.md. continent-app/tests/parseBookingFailures.test.mjs fails when an outcome changes, so the card and the code move together. Not part of the gated eval.
